# endpointcentral_custom_group (Data Source)

Looks up a custom group by its exact (case-sensitive) name, including built-in groups such as `All Mac machines`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Built-in groups can be looked up by name too.
data "endpointcentral_custom_group" "all_macs" {
  name = "All Mac machines"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Exact group name.

### Read-Only

- `category` (String) `static`, `static_unique` or `dynamic`.
- `id` (String) Group ID.
- `member_ids` (Set of String) Resource IDs of the members of a static group; empty for dynamic groups.
- `type` (String) `computer` or `user`.
